title: Reproducing the minimax-regret robustness claim for goal misgeneralization on a tiny proxy-distinguishing environment

original_idea.body:
# Reproducing the Minimax-Regret Robustness Claim

Train MEV vs regret-prioritized agents in a proxy-distinguishing gridworld; measure OOD goal pursuit vs rarity.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: tests a theoretically-characterized robustness fix for goal misgeneralization, a canonical alignment failure.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Small gridworld RL with regret-prioritized sampling; some RL/UED understanding needed but guided.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused two-method comparison varying rarity; RL training adds some.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly: toy env, one GPU, no lab data, robustness verification valuable.

novelty.reasoning: The MMER paper is recent; an independent small-scale probe of the rarity knob may be partially open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: The MMER result is recent; independent rarity-knob probe may be open.
